name: Upsert Row
description: Upsert a row of data in a Google Sheet. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values/append)

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: sheetId
configurable_props.label: Spreadsheet ID
configurable_props.description: Select a spreadsheet or provide a spreadsheet ID

configurable_props.name: worksheetId
configurable_props.label: Worksheet ID
configurable_props.description: Select a worksheet or provide a worksheet ID

configurable_props.name: insert
configurable_props.label: Insert - Cells / Column Values
configurable_props.description: Insert statement: the row data you want to add to the Google sheet if the key *doesn't* exist. If the key *does* exist and **Update** is not set, the row will be updated using this array. Enter individual cell values or enter a custom expression to pass an array with each element representing a cell/column value (e.g. `{{ [5, "test"] }}`).

configurable_props.name: column
configurable_props.label: Key Column
configurable_props.description: The column of the sheet to lookup (e.g. `A`). This column functions as the key column for the upsert operation.

configurable_props.name: value
configurable_props.label: Key Value
configurable_props.description: The value of the key to search for in **Key Column**. Defaults to the value in **Insert**'s "key" column if left blank.

configurable_props.name: updates
configurable_props.label: Update - Column / Values
configurable_props.description:
Update statment: if the spreadsheet contains duplicate key **Value** in some row in the specified **Column**, individual cells in the *first* duplicate row will be updated using this object's column-value pairs.
Enter the column name for the key (e.g. `B`) and the corresponding column value (e.g. `test`). You may also enter a custom expression and pass a JSON object with key/value pairs representing columns and values (e.g. `{{ { A: 5, B: "test" } }}`).
